items.title: I think world models are still in the GPT 3
items.text: I think world models are still in the GPT 3.5 era, but not for long. Like the old Will Smith eating spaghetti videos, world models are impressive but not quite there yet. You can see it in the reel below, which has a mix of my Genie 4 generations and Google's. But once they hit the GPT-5 or GPT-6 stage, I think they'll have massive implications for a lot of industries: Movies - A big effects shot like a dragon battle takes a VFX studio months of work. With a great world model, a director could create a single frame and have AI generate the full scene from it. items.title: Agents are going to consume 1,000X more tokens than we consume today
items.text: Agents are going to consume 1,000X more tokens than we consume today. Because they’re going to be running in our workflows, processing all of our data, building out nearly all software, securing enterprises, and much more. To do this at scale we will need a variety of approaches at the frontier of AI. This includes continuing to push the boundaries of closed models, while also increasing the capability of open weights models, making them more secure, as well as making them more efficient for large workloads. Very exciting to see what @Suhail is building with Particle on this front.

Speaker 2 | 00:18 - 00:40 Depending on who you ask, right now is an apocalypse for creative people, or it's like the best time to be alive ever.
